638:     private static void AppendEmbeddedFile(StringBuilder builder, string fileName, byte[] bytes)
639:     {
640:         var content = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false, throwOnInvalidBytes: true).GetString(bytes);
641:         // A fence longer than any backtick run in the file keeps the embedded
642:         // bytes verbatim and the boundary unambiguous (CommonMark).
643:         var fence = new string('`', Math.Max(3, LongestBacktickRun(content) + 1));
644:         builder.Append($"### {fileName}\n\n");
645:         builder.Append(fence);
646:         builder.Append(fileName);
647:         builder.Append('\n');
648:         builder.Append(content);
649:         if (bytes.Length == 0 || bytes[^1] != (byte)'\n')
650:         {
651:             builder.Append('\n');
652:         }
653: 
654:         builder.Append(fence);
655:         builder.Append("\n\n");
656:     }

658:     internal static int LongestBacktickRun(string content)
659:     {
660:         var longest = 0;
661:         var current = 0;
662:         foreach (var character in content)
663:         {
664:             current = character == '`' ? current + 1 : 0;
665:             longest = Math.Max(longest, current);
666:         }
667: 
668:         return longest;
669:     }

735:         if (!context.Config.CrossRuntimeReview.TryGetDeclared(resolution.Domain, resolution.Team, out var declaration))

742:         var verdictFile = ResolvePath(context, verdictFileArgument);

744:         try

751:                 $"verdict file '{verdictFile}' could not be read: {exception.Message}",

753:         }
754: 
755:         string content;
756:         try
757:         {
758:             content = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false, throwOnInvalidBytes: true).GetString(raw);
759:         }
760:         catch (DecoderFallbackException exception)
761:         {
762:             return Refuse(writer, format, "record", CrossRuntimeReviewCauses.VerdictInvalid,

764:         }

766:         if (!CrossRuntimeReviewVerdict.TryParse(runtime, content, out var verdict, out var observedModel, out var verdictError))

772: 
773:         if (runtime == CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.Copilot

783:         if (runtime == CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.Copilot

843:         string? commentOut = null;

851:                         ? CrossRuntimeReviewCauses.RecordCollision

857:             if (options.TryGetValue("--comment-out", out var commentOutArgument))

863:                     Directory.CreateDirectory(commentDirectory);
864:                 }
865: 
866:                 File.WriteAllText(commentOut, commentBody, new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false));

868:         }

870:         var result = new CrossRuntimeReviewRecordResult

872:             Command = $"{CommandName} record",
